messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — I accepted the org invite but I still can't see private repos like `infra-config`. Trying to clone gives an access denied error. SSO shows my membership as 'Pending'. Anyone know what I'm missing?
Priya Rao: Do you remember which account you accepted the invite with? sometimes people accept with personal GH accidentally. Also check https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/invitation to confirm.
Alex Chen: Ugh I think I accepted with my personal account. The invite email said alex@redwood.ai but my browser was logged in with alex.chen.personal. How do I swap it to my work account without causing chaos?
Sam Miller: We can revoke and resend the invite to the correct account. If you accepted on the wrong account it won't get org membership. Can you paste the exact clone error you see and the email shown on the invite?
Alex Chen: Here's the error when I try to clone (from terminal):
```
Cloning into 'infra-config'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config.git/' not found
```
Also the invite email I received was to alex@redwood.ai (I think the invite landed in work mailbox) but the browser auto-signed-in to my personal account.
Naomi Park: Also double-check two-factor. The org enforces 2FA, and GitHub will block membership until 2FA is enabled on the account that accepts the invite. Quick path: GitHub -> Settings -> Security -> "Two-factor authentication".
Alex Chen: My work account has 2FA enabled. The problem is the browser account mixup. I'm fine with you resending to alex@redwood.ai.
infra-bot: Automated action: revoking pending invitation for user alex.chen.personal (request by Sam Miller) — reason: accepted wrong account.
Sam Miller: Re-sent invite to alex@redwood.ai. When it arrives, please accept while explicitly signed into that account in the browser (or accept from the email link while signed into the correct account). After you accept I'll add you to eng-runtime.
Alex Chen: Got the new invite email, accepted it while signed into work account. The org now shows me as a member and I can see `infra-config` in the web UI :tada:
Priya Rao: Nice. One more thing: for SSH pushes make sure your SSH public key is added to the same GitHub account that is a member of the org. If you added a key to your personal account it won't help.
Sam Miller: Added Alex Chen to team `eng-runtime` with write access. Try cloning over SSH if you prefer: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra-config.git`
Alex Chen: SSH clone works now and I can push. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
thread_body_preview: Alex accepted invite with wrong account, revoke/resend, SSO/2FA checks, infra-bot revoke, accepted with correct account, added to eng-runtime, SSH fix.
